checkpoints.description: [1/3] Plan: fix test mocks, hygiene findings, and README gate drift; then verify and push

impact_assessment.why: AIKit integration surfaced gate failures in an otherwise working project: fragile tkinter mocks, silent exception handlers, missing subprocess timeout, private-attribute coupling, and README cold-start drift.
impact_assessment.benefits: All four Phase 4 gates pass; the repo carries AIKit memory; project is pushable with verified history.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: none; dependency: none added; concurrency: none; state: test harness and error handling change, README structure changes
impact_assessment.mitigation: Keep behavior identical by logging swallowed errors, add timeout only to the test runner, fix mocks without weakening assertions, and verify with the full gate suite before commit.

checkpoints.description: [2/3] Repaired test harness (78 tests pass), logged swallowed errors, added subprocess timeout, removed private-attribute coupling, added README cold-start sections
[3/3] Phase 4 complete: checklists: passed; 4/4 gates (test, hygiene, guidelines, secrets) green

[1/1] Switch NeuralBeat from Apache-2.0 to AGPL-3.0: replace LICENSE with the canonical text, update the README license section, record ADR-001, run all four project gates, commit and push non-destructively

impact_assessment.why: NeuralBeat still ships under Apache-2.0 while the rest of the portfolio uses AGPL-3.0, so GitHub advertises an inconsistent license and the README repeats the old terms
impact_assessment.benefits: One license across the portfolio, correct GitHub detection, README and ADR records that match the shipped LICENSE, and a clean legal contract for contributors
impact_assessment.risks: contract: NeuralBeat moves from permissive Apache-2.0 to copyleft AGPL-3.0; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: none
impact_assessment.mitigation: Use the canonical AGPL-3.0 text, keep the change to LICENSE/README/ADR, run python aikit.py check NeuralBeat, stage explicitly, and push only after the commit is verified

checkpoints.description: [1/1] LICENSE replaced with canonical AGPL-3.0, README license section updated, ADR-001 recorded; checklists: passed (test, hygiene, guidelines, secrets)
